claim: Oura limits an application to 10 users before approval.
quote: By default, API Applications have a ten user limit. If you want to release your application to a wider audience, your application needs to be approved.

claim: There is no limit once approved.
quote: There is no limit once an application is approved.

claim: Oura's API returns 403 when a user's subscription has expired.
quote: The requested resource requires additional permissions or the user's Oura subscription has expired.

claim: Personal access tokens were deprecated in December 2025 and are no longer available.
quote: personal access tokens were deprecated in December 2025 and are no longer available for use.

claim: New WHOOP apps start on a Sandbox tier of 10 members.
quote: Every new app starts on the Sandbox tier, which allows up to 10 WHOOP members to connect.

claim: Garmin's developer program is only for business use.
quote: There are no licensing or maintenance fees for access to the Garmin Connect Developer Program, but it is only for business use.

claim: Some metrics need a license fee or minimum device order for commercial use.
quote: Access to some metrics may require a license fee payment or minimum device order quantity for commercial use.
